2122648704653943179.en_summary: $HD Q3’26 earnings highlights: Revenue $43.4B (Est. $42.8B) +4.9% YoY, Adj. EPS $3.86 (Est. $3.84) +3.2% YoY, Adj. Oper Income $5.66B beat. Comp sales +2.2%.
